description: Verify that data following the urgent pointer (non-urgent data) is NOT delivered to the user in the same buffer as the preceding urgent data (RFC 793 §3.7 Interfaces)
approach:
[Objective]
Urgent data must be split off into its own out-of-band buffer; non-urgent data following it must arrive in the regular data stream — not co-mingled in one application read.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment with URG=1, urgent pointer pointing past some prefix bytes; segment also carries non-urgent suffix bytes.
3. Observation: DUT separates urgent prefix from non-urgent suffix in two distinct read buffers.

[Pass condition]
UT verifies that the urgent and non-urgent bytes were delivered separately.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_proper_urgent_data — DUT did not isolate urgent data

verdicts.Pass: DUT isolated urgent vs non-urgent data — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_proper_urgent_data: DUT did not isolate urgent data
